subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw provide a shared immediate acknowledgement lifecycle with channel capability fallbacks, or keep visible progress as channel-owned draft/placeholder behavior?
rationale: The requested feature spans delivery ownership, persistent-message versus editable-draft semantics, cleanup on failure and `NO_REPLY`, and a compatibility-sensitive configuration surface; current code and documentation show useful but non-equivalent channel implementations.

options.title: Define a shared lifecycle contract
options.body: Specify portable acknowledgement, update, completion, and fallback semantics first, then implement the smallest shared API or config surface.

options.title: Keep channel-owned progress
options.body: Decline a universal text setting and let each channel expose its own editable draft or placeholder behavior where its transport supports it.

options.title: Retain existing signals only
options.body: Keep ack reactions and typing/progress surfaces without adding a visible text acknowledgement feature.

recommendation.title: Define a shared lifecycle contract
recommendation.body: Specify portable acknowledgement, update, completion, and fallback semantics first, then implement the smallest shared API or config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared dispatch and acknowledgement-lifecycle history provides the closest ownership signal for selecting the product boundary.
